name: Office, Wi-Fi 6E (example)
description: One worked example, not a recommendation. It assumes every person carries three devices: a laptop, a work phone and a personal phone, at one each per head. The laptop is mostly on a normal SLA with a tenth of it conferencing; the work phone splits evenly between normal and background; the personal phone is almost all background. Your mix will differ - capture your own from an .esx rather than editing this by hand. Every profile named here is Ekahau stock content, present in a new project, so this template applies without creating anything.
capturedFrom: hand-authored; profile names verified against 109 real projects
